chunks: He said: Abul Hasan Muhammad ibn al-Muzaffar reported to me, saying: Muhammad ibn Jarir narrated to us, saying: Ahmad ibn Ismail narrated to me, from Abdul al-Razzaq ibn Hammam who said: Ma'mar informed us, from al-Zuhri, from Ubaidullah ibn Abdullah ibn Utbah, from Abdullah ibn Abbas, may Allah have mercy on him, who said:
The Prophet, may Allah bless him and his family, looked at Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him, and said: A master in this world and a master in the Hereafter.
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about Ali being a master in this world and the Hereafter?
ai.summary: This hadith records the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) bestowing a remarkable title upon Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (AS), declaring him a master in both the temporal and eternal worlds. The narration was transmitted through a chain including prominent scholars such as al-Zuhri and Ibn Abbas, lending it cross-sectarian significance.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him
